name: ProofBlazer
author: blazersio

sections.description:
ProofBlazer is an easy-to-use plugin that connects your WordPress or WooCommerce site with the ProofBlazer platform. Display real-time notifications like recent purchases, sign-ups, or custom messages to boost your site’s credibility and drive more conversions.

  • Seamlessly integrates with your ProofBlazer account
  • Automatically injects the script via your API key
  • Clean UI to manage settings
  • Lightweight and fast

External Services

This plugin connects to the ProofBlazer service in order to display real-time social proof notifications on your website.

When the plugin is active and configured with your API key, it loads an external JavaScript file from:

  • https://proof.blazers.io

What data is sent

  • Your site’s API key is sent to ProofBlazer servers to authenticate and retrieve the correct notification widget.
  • No personal user information is collected by this plugin.

Why the data is sent

  • The API key is required to link your site to your ProofBlazer account and display the correct widget.

Service provider

This service is provided by ProofBlazer (https://blazers.io).
– Terms of Service: https://blazers.io/termsofservice
– Privacy Policy: https://blazers.io/privacypolicy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ProofBlazer settings page.
  4. Paste your API key from https://proof.blazers.io/install_code (you need to be logged in to your ProofBlazer account to access this page) and click Save.
sections.faq:
Do I need a ProofBlazer account?

Yes. You need to create an account at https://proof.blazers.io to generate your API key.

Will it slow down my website?

No. The script loads asynchronously and is optimized for performance.
